title: Winning Streaks & Losing Streaks

launchpad.outcome: Hold your baseline through a losing streak and a winning streak, and read your emotional temperature.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Did the plan change, or did my streak change?

slides.title: Same trader. Different week.
slides.verdict: BOTH CAN PULL YOU AWAY FROM BASELINE.

slides.title: Written before the streak

options.label: Yes, rewrite it
options.feedback: Five losses can happen inside a working edge. Review execution and sample first.

options.label: Not automatically
options.why: Review execution + sample. Don’t rewrite the method after a streak.

options.label: Yes, triple size
options.feedback: Your confidence changed. Did your risk plan?

options.label: NO
options.why: Same risk. Same baseline. Wins don’t make the next trade safer.

slides.punch: DON’T LET LOSSES CONVINCE YOU THE EDGE DISAPPEARED. DON’T LET WINS CONVINCE YOU RISK DISAPPEARED.

slides.title: Emotional temperature
slides.body: Where would you put each thought? This is for noticing, not grading yourself.

asks.prompt: She’s 🔴 in a revenge state. A fully valid setup begins forming. Does her emotional state make the MARKET SETUP invalid?

options.label: YES
options.feedback: The setup is about price. Her state is about her. Two different dimensions.

options.label: NO
options.why: Market setup and trader readiness are different dimensions.

asks.prompt: Then does her personal trading plan need a rule for what she does when she’s in this state?

options.label: YES
options.why: Exactly. Not invented now. Section 2 is where you build it.

slides.punch: A RED STATE DOESN’T MAKE THE SETUP INVALID. IT MAKES YOUR PERSONAL RULE MATTER MORE.

slides.quote: Your baseline is the version of you that wrote the plan. Trade like her.

slides.prompt: Why can winning trades reinforce bad habits?
slides.modelAnswer: Because a win feels like proof. After a streak I might size up or loosen my rules, and if it works, the bad habit gets rewarded. My baseline risk didn’t change just because I won.

takeaways: Losses ≠ broken edge. Wins ≠ no risk.
Temperature is self-observation, not a signal.
remember: DON’T LET WINS CONVINCE YOU RISK DISAPPEARED.
